phenotypes.Poor Metabolizer: Greatly reduced conversion to morphine. Inadequate analgesia. Alternative non-CYP2D6 analgesic strongly recommended.
phenotypes.Intermediate Metabolizer: Reduced morphine generation. May exhibit blunted pain relief; monitor response closely.
phenotypes.Normal Metabolizer: Expected therapeutic analgesic conversion. Standard label dosing indicated.
phenotypes.Ultra-Rapid Metabolizer: Markedly increased conversion to morphine. Severe life-threatening opioid toxicity/respiratory depression risk. AVOID USE.

phenotypes.Intermediate Metabolizer: Sub-therapeutic platelet inhibition. Consider alternative P2Y12 inhibitor.
phenotypes.Normal Metabolizer: Normal active metabolite activation and antiplatelet effect. Standard label dosing.
phenotypes.Ultra-Rapid Metabolizer: Normal or slightly enhanced platelet inhibition; standard dosing.
